summary: Iter197 verified the five Tonbridge Warehouse display changes: (1) StockBadge on product rows now stacks pieces + m² (StockBadge with 10 PIECE / 3.60 m² confirmed via screenshot on TEST-M2 product with sqm_per_piece=0.36). (2) 'Group by product' toggle present, default ON, expand/collapse works, OFF shows flat rows. (3) Recent Adjustments header column renamed from 'REASON' to 'DETAILS'. (4) Batch cards render bold black BATCH NUMBER pill (font-black text-lg), Unslotted pill for missing location (blue-600 pill would render for real locations per code), oversized emerald text-3xl font-black pieces total. (5) Backend GET /warehouse/products/{id}/batches now enriches each batch with total_m2 (3.60 for 10 pieces × 0.36 sqm_per_piece). Regression check for deleted_at filter also passes. Backend: 5/5 focused tests pass. Frontend: all UI display changes confirmed visually.  ONE BUG FOUND: batch cards in BatchesPanel do NOT show the m² subtotal because the SEARCH endpoint /warehouse/products (which BatchesPanel reads product.batches from) does NOT compute total_m2 on batches — only the /products/{id}/batches endpoint does. The frontend never calls the latter. Fix: either enrich batches in the search endpoint OR make BatchesPanel fetch fresh batches from /products/{id}/batches on expand.

ui_bugs.issue: Batch card m² subtotal line NEVER renders because BatchesPanel reads product.batches from the /warehouse/products search endpoint, which does NOT enrich batches with total_m2. Confirmed via UI screenshot (batch card shows '10 PIECES' but no '3.60 m²' subtotal even for a product with sqm_per_piece=0.36) and via curl: the search endpoint returns total_m2:null in embedded batches while /warehouse/products/{id}/batches correctly returns total_m2:3.6. Owner requirement (d) 'an m² subtotal below pieces when total_m2 is provided' is silently not-provided.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the batch-card m² miss: two backend endpoints return batches (search + per-product), but only the per-product endpoint was updated in this iteration to compute total_m2. The frontend BatchesPanel reads batches from the search endpoint's embedded array (product.batches) — so the enrichment never reaches the UI. Fix in one place: apply the same m2_per_piece derivation used in list_product_batches inside search_warehouse_products' batch loop (~L390-396). The frontend already renders the m² subtotal correctly when total_m2 is populated — verified by DOM inspection of the guard `batch.total_m2 != null && Number(batch.total_m2) > 0`.
